async def act(page):
    # Wait for any pending navigation from previous action
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Check current URL to see if we are on the Customers page
    current_url = page.url
    if 'customers' not in current_url.lower():
        # If not on Customers page, click the Customers link again
        await page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name='Customers').click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Now look for the 'Orders' link on the Customers page
    # Since the accessibility tree doesn't show it, I'll try to find it by role and name
    try:
        await page.get_by_role('link', name='Orders').click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    except:
        # If 'Orders' link not found, try to find it under a menu or other structure
        # Look for any link containing 'Orders' in its name
        await page.get_by_role('link', name='Orders', exact=False).first.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
